messages:
Asha: Quick sync - creating a tiny customer-facing 'fast-start' runbook for pilots. Focus: keep onboarding touches light, avoid cold starts, and surface renewal risk within 7 days.
Ben: Good. One-pager + 5-step checklist sounds right. Include simple metrics to watch.
Ivy: Recommend warmup pattern: 1) client-side dedupe cache, 2) prefill top 8 intents 1h before launch, 3) enable streaming with 200ms prefix window.
Asha: Also want a short telemetry packet customers can share: sessions_last_24h, median_latency_ms, failed_stream_pct, tokens_per_session.
Ben: Renewal flag: if sessions_growth < 0.1 AND nps_48h <= 6 OR failed_stream_pct > 3% -> flag for outreach. Keep it explainable.
Ivy: Ops appendix: curl probe for CS to run and paste output in ticket.
ops-bot: Reminder set - /remind @Ben to draft one-pager on 2026-03-30 09:00 PDT.
Asha: Add rollback steps: disable streaming, switch route to cached variant, escalate to eng if median latency > 800ms for 10m. Keep checklist <=5 items.
Ben: I'll draft and post a PDF + YAML example by EOD.
Asha: Thanks 680, will merge after review.
